Where a figure cannot be worked out, this screen says so and says why — it will not show you a zero it does not mean. Business date 107 orders closed on this trading day The day's money GROSS SALES Rs 113,197.00 Full menu price of everything sold, before any discount. DISCOUNTS Rs 662.30 Given away. Shown here rather than netted into a smaller sales figure. COMPS Not known Comps are not recorded separately from discounts. orders.discount_paisa is one column, and a full comp appears in it as a discount equal to the subtotal. Splitting them would require a field POS does not capture. NET SALES Rs 112,534.70 Gross sales less discounts. Tax and service charge are NOT in this figure — this is the revenue line.
